cohort: The study included 22,166 women who gave birth within the Illawarra Shoalhaven Local Health District (ISLHD) between 2017 and 2022.
finding: Pregnant women exposed to pandemic restrictions within ISLHD had decreased odds of adverse antenatal and neonatal outcomes, but increased odds of poor peripartum outcomes, including non-reassuring fetal status and postpartum haemorrhage.
